messages:
sasha: Heads-up — I'm putting together the release brief for the ImageGen rollout (v2). Planning to publish to /whats-new tomorrow AM. Main callouts: streaming preview, prompt templates, and a new aspect-ratio hint param. Draft here: https://redwood.internal/docs/drafts/imagegen-v2

maria: Quick question — are we mentioning the known issue where alpha channel is dropped when using 1024x1024? That came up in QA and we should surface it in the known-issues section.

kevin: yes, +1 to call that out. Also include the SDK snippet change: `images.generate()` now uses `response_mode: "streaming"` by default. Our old snippet will break clients.

chris: I started a PR with the new snippets: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4123 — needs a copy review and linkcheck. I flagged two redirect links that will fail on prod.

maria: sasha can you add a tiny migration blurb? e.g., `if you relied on full-RGBA output, set format: "png_with_alpha"` and link to the migration guide. Short bullet under breaking changes.

sasha: Good call. I'll add a one-line migration note and include this code example:

```js
// new streaming example
const resp = await redwood.images.generate({
  prompt: 'Aerial photo of Portland, wide aspect',
  size: '1024x768',
  aspect_hint: 'widescreen',
  response_mode: 'streaming'
});
for await (const chunk of resp) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.preview)
}
```

kevin: Looks good. Can you also update SDK notes to recommend `size` enums instead of manual strings? People copy/paste and end up with unsupported sizes.

sasha: Will do. Also, @docs-bot can you run the link-checker on the draft branch once I push the PR? I remember docs-bot has the /linkcheck command.

docs-bot: /linkcheck started on branch docs/imagegen-v2 — posting results when complete :mag:

chris: FYI — we should add a short sentence in the announcement about runtime fallback: when GPU pool is saturated we fallback to the cheaper CPU model with degraded quality (and mention latency impact). Avoid surprises for enterprise customers.

maria: Agreed. Also add a short snippet for known workaround for the alpha channel: `convert -alpha set` on the client side if they need to re-add it.

sasha: Ok, next steps: I will: 1) push PR with updated snippets + migration blurb, 2) add known-issues note about alpha drop and fallback behavior, 3) wait for docs-bot linkcheck and Kevin's review on size enums. Plan to publish draft at 09:00 PT tomorrow unless any blockers.

kevin: I'll do a quick review after you push. Please ping me in thread. :thumbsup:

chris: I can help with the announcement blurb and a short checklist for support on rollout day.

sasha: Thanks — pinging when PR is up.

docs-bot: /linkcheck complete — 2 broken redirects found (imagegen/examples -> /images/examples-v2, docs/migration -> /migrate).

maria: I'll open the redirects ticket and attach the PR reference.

sasha: Perfect, thanks everyone.
